text:
Maya Perez: Heads up — NimbusPay API usage dropped 62% week-over-week; renewal Q2. Also see procurement ping about AtlasAI pilot. Anyone tracking what's happening?
Liam Chen: I saw the procurement thread. They're running a competitive eval with AtlasAI. We have a Thu slot with procurement at 3pm PT. Need clarifying ask from them.
Ritika Singh: Can we get recent error/latency logs? If their calls are failing we should surface that in the renewal convo.
Maya Perez: Linking dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/nimbuspay/usage — topline: token volume down, errors small bump but not correlated to drop. Champion Alex left last week; new ML lead is Priya (cc'd in procurement).
Liam Chen: Got it. That champion churn + procurement evaluation explains it. Plan suggestion: offer a 2-week Dedicated trial + one week free onboarding to show stable p99 and predictable costs.
Ritika Singh: Agree. Also propose a burst capacity promo and a tailored quantization profile to cut costs. I'll prep p50/p95/p99 numbers and cost sim for 100k calls/day.
Maya Perez: I'll intro Priya to Ritika and send the usage slice + any error traces we saw. I'll also slot the Thu 3pm PT call and add a QBR agenda item.
Priya Patel: Hi team — thanks for the quick loop. Our priority is deterministic billing and <100ms p95 at 512 tokens. Please include p99 numbers and a cost table for 100k calls/day.
Ritika Singh: Noted — we'll include latency at 128/512 tokens, quantized model options, and cost per 100k.
Liam Chen: Next steps owners: Maya — intro + dashboard slice; Ritika — perf + trial config + SLOs; Liam — commercial/draft discount. I'll share a renewal outline by EOD.
Maya Perez: Sounds good. No objections to the 2-week Dedicated trial with onboarding week? :thumbsup:
Priya Patel: :thumbsup: looking forward to the call.
Ritika Singh: I'll draft the trial template and a quick runbook for onboarding hours.
Liam Chen: Adding follow-up: if they still lean AtlasAI, request the evaluation criteria so we can tailor the trial. @Maya can you capture that on the call?
Maya Perez: Yep will capture criteria and next steps.
notif-bot: Reminder — Thu 3pm PT call scheduled with NimbusPay procurement (calendar invite sent).
